notice.unreachable: The local service could not be reached.
notice.invalidHttp: The local service returned an invalid HTTP {status} response.
notice.fileUnreadable: The selected file could not be read.
notice.exportInvalid: The recovery export response failed its protocol checks.
notice.incomplete: Check the reported outcome before trying again. If it is unconfirmed, inspect Recovery.
notice.definitionMismatch: The installed Web contract does not match these browser assets. Reload after publishing matching assets.
notice.missingCsrf: Authenticated session did not include an antiforgery token.
notice.digestUnavailable: The exact recovery digest is unavailable; inspect the preparation.
notice.exportStarted: Recovery export started. The file contains claimant data; keep it private.
notice.inspectBeforeRetry: Inspect Recovery before retrying this exact operation.
notice.inspectBeforeAction: Inspect Recovery before taking another action.
notice.keptForRecovery: Prepared request is retained. Use Recovery to inspect, resolve, or dismiss it.
notice.unknownDiagnostic: An explanation is unavailable. Follow the reported outcome and recovery guidance; do not infer permission to retry.
notice.cancelled: This request was cancelled. Earlier attempts are not settled by this cancellation.
notice.cancelledBeforeAdmission: This request was cancelled before admission. Earlier attempts are not settled by this cancellation.
notice.cancelledBeforeAttempt: This request was cancelled before a new attempt. Inspect exact evidence for any earlier unresolved attempts.
